DIRECTORS’ REPORT 3.1 Operating Results On behalf of the Board of Directors of Waves Corporation Limited, formerly Waves Singer Pakistan Limited (WAVES or the Company), we are pleased to submit the Directors’ Report and audited financial statements of your Company for the year ended 31 December 2025 (Consolidated and Standalone), together with the Auditors’ Report thereon. Alhamdulillah, demand for WAVES branded products remained robust, supported by our continued commitment to high-quality, market-oriented, and innovative offerings.
